text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync: we need a lightweight onboarding plan for aurora-7 that balances customer pins and platform risk. Customers want a clear adoption runway, not irreversible locks. Thoughts on a 'staged-stable' approach?
Elena (Prod): Staged-stable = 10% tenant opt-in for 30d, then 50% opt-in window for co-tenants, then GA. It gives customers runway without global hard pins.
Raj (Infra): infra constraints: memory/kv behavior varies by variant. If many tenants opt-in, we must cap concurrent pinned tenants to avoid eviction storms. Recommend tenant quota of 20 pinned tenants in STAGE_2.
Chris (Bench): benchmark proposal: two sets - micro (latency/cold-start) and macro (cost per 1k tokens, regression on standard prompt set). Gate for GA: single-request p95 <= 300ms, regression delta <= 2% on quality evals, cost delta <= 20% vs baseline.
Maya (CS): one mid-market customer asked for a 4-month pin during migration. We prefer 3 months max for staged-stable. Can we offer bridging credits or SLA credits for the remainder?
Alex (Sales): yes, credits are doable if we tie them to measurable regressions. Also require them to sign the temporary pin SLA annex.
Priya (PM): legal?
LegalBot: Hard pins >90 days require Legal + Security approval. We'll need an annex that defines rollback mechanisms and cost adjustments.
Raj (Infra): technical mitigation: implement tenant-routing with a fallback flag and a dynamic capacity token. Routing policy example:
```json
{
  "model_id":"aurora-7",
  "pin_mode":"staged-stable",
  "opt_in_pct":10,
  "tenant_quota":20,
  "fallback":"aurora-7-lite",
  "capacity_token":"stage-2-capacity"
}
```
Chris (Bench): also add observability: per-tenant rolling p95, per-tenant token-cost-hourly, and per-tenant quality-diff daily. These are required for SLA credits and rollback decisions.
Priya (PM): ok decisions emerging: (1) adopt staged-stable onboarding, (2) bench gates as Chris proposed, (3) infra quota of 20 pinned tenants during stage-2, (4) allow sales to negotiate up to 3-month pins + credits, (5) legal to prepare annex for any >3mo pin.
Alex (Sales): action: I'll confirm the customer's migration window and push for 3mo + credit.
Maya (CS): action: I'll prepare a migration checklist for pinned tenants (cache invalidation, KV namespace mapping, rollback plan).
Raj (Infra): action: I'll ship tenant_quota enforcement + routing fallback by EOW.
Chris (Bench): action: I'll run a 48h soak and publish bench report.
Priya (PM): thanks. Target: draft catalog entry and RFC by next Tue.
deploy-bot: Draft created: model-catalog entry aurora-7 (draft-id=mc-aurora7-staged).
Elena (Prod): tiny follow-up: add auto-throttle if running cost_per_1k > $0.18 for >1h to protect customers and infra.
Priya (PM): noted. Closing thread; reopen if legal or sales updates.
